files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the posts as cards: a grid, a list of horizontal cards, or a magazine (the first
  post wide, the rest in a grid). Axes: layout (grid, list, magazine), columns, media, meta (full, short, news),
  filter mode (none, topics), pager (none, pages), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { PostTopic, PostFilter, PostPager } from "./post-grid.types";
import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";
import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

export type PostGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  posts: Post[];
  labels: PostLabels;
  action?: HeadLink;
  filter?: PostFilter;
  pager?: PostPager;
  layout?: "grid" | "list" | "magazine";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  meta?: "full" | "short" | "news";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Pager from "../components/pager.vue";
import PostCard from "../blocks/post-card.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import Switcher from "../components/switcher.vue";
import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.vue";
import { fitCols, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  posts,
  labels,
  action,
  filter,
  pager,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  media = "image",
  meta = "full",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<PostGridProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ topic: [value: string], page: [page: number] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :action="action"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'compact' : 'default')"
    :measure="(((meta as string) === 'news') ? 'fill' : 'default')"
    :class="(((meta as string) === 'news') ? 'py-0' : '')"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Switcher v-if="(filter?.mode === 'topics')" :label="filter?.label">
      <SwitcherItem
        v-for="tab in filter?.topics"
        :key="tab.id"
        :active="(tab.value === filter?.topic)"
        @click="() => emit('topic', tab.value)"
      >
        {{ tab.title }}
      </SwitcherItem>
    </Switcher>
    <template v-if="((posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0) > 0)">
      <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'magazine')" gap="6" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
        <template v-for="(p, i) in posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)" :key="p.id">
          <PostCard
            v-if="(i === 0)"
            :post="p"
            :labels="labels"
            layout="horizontal"
            :media="media"
            :meta="meta"
            :density="density"
          />
        </template>
        <Grid :cols="cols" class="gap-6">
          <template v-for="(p, i) in posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)" :key="p.id">
            <PostCard v-if="(i > 0)" :post="p" :labels="labels" :media="media" :meta="meta" :density="density" />
          </template>
        </Grid>
      </Stack>
      <Grid v-else
        :cols="
          (layout as string) === 'list' ? '1'
          : fitCols(cols, (posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0))
        "
        class="w-full gap-6"
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <PostCard v-for="p in posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)" :key="p.id"
          :post="p"
          :labels="labels"
          :layout="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical')"
          :media="media"
          :meta="meta"
          :density="density"
        />
      </Grid>
    </template>
    <Block v-if="((pager?.mode === 'pages') && ((posts.filter((i) => !filter?.topic || i['category'] === filter?.topic)?.length ?? 0) > 0))"
      tag="nav"
      :aria-label="
        landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl('{0}, {1}', pager?.label, landmarkLabel))
        : pager?.label
      "
      data-testid="posts-pager"
    >
      <Pager
        :page="(pager?.page ?? 1)"
        :pages="(pager?.pages ?? 1)"
        :summary="tpl(pager?.summary, (pager?.page ?? 1), (pager?.pages ?? 1))"
        :previousLabel="(pager?.previous ?? '')"
        :nextLabel="(pager?.next ?? '')"
        :numbered="true"
        :pageLabel="pager?.pageLabel"
        :pageUrl="pager?.url"
        :firstUrl="pager?.firstUrl"
        @page="(arg: number) => emit('page', arg)"
      />
    </Block>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
